description: Universal physical constants and default simulation grid settings. SI units throughout.

zero_g.label: Zero-G (ideal)
zero_g.note: Purely diffusive spherical flames; no buoyant convection.

iss_micro_g.label: ISS Micro-G (g-jitter)
iss_micro_g.note: Residual acceleration varies 1e-6 to 1e-3 g; adds slight asymmetry to diffusion-dominated flames.

earth_1g.label: Earth 1G
earth_1g.note: Buoyant convection dominates; classic teardrop flame morphology.

mars_g.label: Mars 0.38G
mars_g.note: Mission-relevant partial gravity for habitat fire-safety analysis.

moon_g.label: Moon 0.165G
moon_g.note: Mission-relevant partial gravity for habitat fire-safety analysis.
